description: This Java source file defines a service class 'UpdateCodeCommandHandler' that handles update commands for 'CODE' entities within the Apache Fineract project. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and uses the 'CodeWritePlatformService' to perform update operations within a transactional context.
